messages:
incident-bot: :loud_sound: PAGING: Inference-serving (us-west-2) p99 latency spike >5s for streaming endpoints. Detected 2026-03-15T14:02Z. Auto-suspect: control-plane configfetch + auth token store rate spikes. Paging oncall.
Aarti K: saw it, joining. direct impact to customers on streaming and chat completions? any errors in logs?
Ben L: yes, some streams are stalling mid-response. p95 ~ 1.2s -> 2.8s, p99 jumped to ~5.4s. Spike started ~14:01Z, correlated with configfetch 503s from configstore.
Chen W: on it. noticed a sharp increase in auth token fetch latency from token-store (500ms -> 2s) and a burst of 429s from rate-limiter. Could be cascading backpressure into request routing.
Diego R: adding quick summary for customer-impact: a handful of active sessions had streaming stalls for ~10-20s and some completed requests timed out. No broad 5xxs from inference runtime itself.
Aarti K: can we get a quick look at feature flag syncs? I remember a rollout earlier that touched prefix caching behavior.
Chen W: checking flags. feature-flags service shows a leader election around 13:59Z, and our flag sync fanout spiked. Affected path: controlplane -> configstore -> model-routing -> inference gateway.
Ben L: logs snippet from gateway:
```
2026-03-15T14:01:23.456Z WARN gateway: kv-cache-miss prefix fetch failed, fallback to controlplane
2026-03-15T14:01:23.789Z ERROR controlplane: configfetch timeout (504) for customer-config shard-17
2026-03-15T14:01:24.001Z WARN auth: tokenstore fetch 429 rate_limited
```
Emma S: streaming infra shows sustained concurrent inflight requests up ~35% — batching queues lengthened. The runtime kept CPU fine but waiting on controlplane replies (prefix KV and flags) so tails blow up.
Aarti K: immediate mitigation ideas? We should avoid touching infra we can't revert. Options: 1) flip routing to local KV-cache fallback for a short window, 2) temporarily increase rate-limiter allowance for controlplane calls (risky), 3) route traffic to a less-affected region.
Diego R: recommend: enable local prefix KV-cache fallback (1) and open a small canary bypass for configfetch fanout (3) as backup. Avoid changing global rate limits unless necessary.
Chen W: I can enable local KV-cache fallback on the gateway in 1 region (us-west-2) via config flag: `gateway.config.kv_cache_local=true`. Patch ready:
```
kubectl patch deploy gateway-usw2 -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"kv-cache-local":"true"}}}}}'
```
Ben L: rolling that now to 3 pods, will watch p99.
Aarti K: notify SRE that we might need to scale controlplane read replicas if configfetch volume persists.
oncall-bot: @oncall pager — Alice (primary) acknowledged the page at 14:04Z. Followup: oncall handoff in 30m if unresolved.
Ben L: kv-cache-local=true applied to gateway-usw2. Observability: within 60s p99 dropped from 5.4s -> 1.1s for streaming endpoints. A few stale responses still from inflight streams but new requests are much improved.
Emma S: dashboards: throughput stable, error rate down. Still seeing a minority of long tails caused by requests that hit controlplane mid-stream. We'll drain those.
Chen W: digging into configstore: we saw a GC coupled with leader rebalancing at ~13:58Z causing a temporary fanout stall. There's a backlog of ~6k pending configfetch RPCs that timed out.
Diego R: customer-impact note for ops: some customers hitting long stalls; we should prepare a short post-incident note if the backlog caused >1% error increase across active accounts.
Aarti K: action items: (1) keep kv-cache-local until backlog clears; (2) add a transient canary route to us-east-1 for heavy customers; (3) add an alert to detect leader election + fanout spikes earlier.
Ben L: implementing canary route for heavy customers now: update routing policy for traffic-tag heavy -> prefer east-1. Patch:
```
redwoodctl route update --tag heavy --prefer-region us-east-1 --ttl 15m
```
Chen W: configstore team says they're throttling fanout retries. They'll apply a hotfix to reduce leader GC pause and add backpressure smoothing in ~45m.
oncall-bot: note: Alice handed off to Bob in 30 minutes as scheduled. Handoff ack required: @Bob
Bob (not in thread) not present.
Emma S: operational note: streaming clients that were mid-response may need a client-side reconnect; we've added a short retry header for 10s reconnect guidance.
Aarti K: timeline for RCA and followups: interim RCA in 2h, full postmortem in 3 business days. Assign owners: configstore (Chen), gateway/local-cache (Ben), alerts/runbook (Emma).
Chen W: verifying backlog drain. Currently pending RPCs 6k -> 800 after 8m. If drain continues we'll start deprecating kv-cache-local fallback after 15m of stable p99 < 1.2s.
Ben L: p99 currently 0.9s, p95 0.45s. Marking page as mitigated but still monitoring. Keeping page open until configstore patch lands.
Aarti K: thumbs up. Prepare customer comms draft if configstore rollback impacts persist. I'll loop in support with suggested wording.
incident-bot: Incident status: MITIGATED -> active monitoring. Severity lowered. Next update in 20m or on owner update.
Diego R: small post-action: add metric to correlate feature-flag leader changes with controlplane fetch latency. Looks like a blind spot.
Chen W: patch applied by configstore team at 14:46Z, leader GC smoothed. Backlog drained to 0 by 14:50Z.
Ben L: removed kv-cache-local at 14:55Z, p99 stable at 0.8s. Closing handoff: Alice -> Bob follow-up for postmortem.
Aarti K: handing off to oncall for postmortem. Please include timeline, root cause (leader GC + fanout spike), mitigation (kv-cache-local, canary routing), and next steps (alerting + smoothing). Thanks everyone. :tada:
